# Connector full reference

## Short description
Connector is a self-hosted operating substrate for intelligence. It sits between agents and the worlds they can reach so teams can isolate, govern, stop, and prove — on a node they operate.

## What Connector is
Identity, admission, isolation, memory, and audit on one `connector-platform` node (default :9091).

Ready institutions (try in 90 minutes): DevGuard, TraceTramp, WitnessCtl.

Planned SKUs: Conductor, AgentLoop, LedgerLens, AgentPassport, Relay, Engram, Support/CX.

## What Connector is not
- Not an LLM or a coding-agent product
- Not an agent framework
- Not Firecracker-by-default
- Not a sold SOC 2 / HIPAA / FedRAMP certification
- Stop is not undo of world effects that already happened

## Search intents
- AI agent governance / control plane
- AI policy enforcement and audit trails
- self-hosted agent isolation (world cage, Landlock pores)
- HMAC-chained receipts for admitted actions
